title: A Bernoulli Phase-Fitted finite difference method with wavenumber-explicit analysis for the Helmholtz problem
summary: A new Bernoulli phase-fitted finite difference method for the Helmholtz equation is introduced, obtained by applying a complexified Scharfetter--Gummel flux to the one-way factors of the operator. The rigorous analysis is developed for the one-dimensional Helmholtz problem with impedance boundary conditions. For the homogeneous problem, the scheme reproduces sampled plane-waves exactly, both in the interior and at the discrete impedance boundary closures.
